sourceChecks.text: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベニヤミン族の人々を数える際、アビダンはギデオニの子として名が挙がります。

sourceChecks.text: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベニヤミン族の人々を数える際、アビダンはギデオニの子として名が挙がります。

sourceChecks.text: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベニヤミン族の人々を数える際、アビダンはギデオニの子として名が挙がります。

sourceChecks.text: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
